title: With Heart and Blood - How to Earn & Missable Status (Phantom Blade Zero)
description: With Heart and Blood trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and rarity once the list is public.
keyword: With Heart and Blood phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: This is the gold that makes the true ending compulsory for the platinum. The prerequisite checklist is on the true ending page: nine purple side quests, four retainer masks, five dragon pillars and both crystal puppet eyes.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content:
Reach the All Comes to Light ending - the true ending.

  1. Finish all nine purple-marked side quests before climbing Mount Soulrend.
  2. Collect the four retainer masks.
  3. Light all five dragon pillars.
  4. Obtain both crystal puppet eyes.
  5. Complete the final boss chain without leaving the area.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
